Earnings growth for the most recent year cannot be directly compared to the five-year average due to continued unprofitability, and net profit margins have not shown improvement. Revenue growth is forecast at 10.1% per year, slightly lagging behind the US market average of 10.4%. Its GAAP profit of $0.16 per share was significantly above analysts’ consensus estimates.
